claims.evidence: witness could not read the model; identity model is null
photos show scanner platen and control panel but not printing or scanning operation
report describes visible parts but not wear or overall condition
report states whether it powers on and whether functions work is not shown
functionality is not demonstrated in the report

risks.proof: video clip of the machine powering on (display lights, fan)
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working / for parts only

risks.risk: Copy, print or scan functions do not work
risks.proof: video of a test copy being made and a scan completed

risks.risk: Toner or drum is depleted or near end of life
risks.proof: photo of the toner cartridge and drum unit, or control-panel readout of remaining life
risks.if_unproven: priced with no usable toner included

risks.risk: High meter reading or unknown age
risks.proof: photo or screenshot of the meter/page count from the control panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage with unknown age

risks.risk: Power cable, toner cartridge or other accessories missing
risks.proof: photo of all included accessories alongside the machine

risks.risk: Hidden damage to rear, bottom, or paper trays
risks.proof: photos of the rear, bottom, and paper trays
risks.if_unproven: priced allowing for hidden physical damage

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and making a test copy
Photo of the control panel showing the model number and meter/page count
Photo of the toner cartridge, drum unit, and all included accessories
Photos of the rear, bottom, and paper trays
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a Sharp office photocopier, so a worst-case floor price can be set even assuming it does not work and lacks toner; proof would only raise the price.
